tier_a.name: Tier A: Regulators & Government
tier_a.description: Statutory authorities, government ministries, state food safety departments, and official product recall or safety notifications.
entities: FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India)
NCPCR (National Commission for Protection of Child Rights)

tier_b.name: Tier B: FSSAI-Notified & NABL-Accredited Labs
tier_b.description: Independent analytical testing laboratories officially notified by FSSAI or listed in the National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL) directory with valid scope.

tier_c.name: Tier C: Independent Testing Organisations
tier_c.description: Independent consumer advocacy testing organisations and comparative testing platforms. Include Trustified ONLY when the primary underlying laboratory report PDF is attached or directly accessible.
entities: Ministry of Consumer Affairs Comparative Testing (consumeraffairs.nic.in)

tier_d.name: Tier D: Peer-Reviewed Studies & Composition Data
tier_d.description: Peer-reviewed scientific journals, academic studies, and national food composition reference tables (e.g. ICMR-NIN Indian Food Composition Tables). Shown for educational context only; never changes a verdict.

creator_rules.section_1_requirement: Creator content enters Section 1 ONLY if it directly links an original, accessible laboratory test report or official regulatory document that strictly satisfies all 7 acceptance rules. Otherwise, it is placed in Section 2 as unverified social commentary.
